name: Fishing Girl's Fantasy
detailed_description:
​

Game Introduction​

Have you ever dreamed of enjoying the tranquility of fishing in serene waters or imagined running your own unique restaurant, turning your catch into delicious dishes for guests from all over? In Fishing Girl's Fantasy, both desires come true! You’ll inherit a seaside diner and embark on a relaxing journey filled with fishing, exploration, gourmet cuisine, and unforgettable encounters.

Whether you’re a fishing novice or a seasoned pro, Fishing Girl's Fantasy offers something for everyone. With diverse techniques like float fishing and lure casting, each location—from serene streams and glacial polar regions to vast open seas—hides breathtaking scenery and unexpected surprises waiting to be uncovered.

​Rich Fishing Experience​

The game meticulously designs dozens of distinct fish species, ranging from adorable to awe-inspiring. Wield specialized rods, experiment with various baits and techniques, challenge rare catches, unlock your encyclopedia, and savor the pure joy of fishing.

Collect fish species inspired by global cultures, including prehistoric creatures (note: remember to release protected species after catching them!).

​Simulation Gameplay​

After a fruitful haul, dive into restaurant management. Craft signature dishes using fresh catches, design unique menus, and experiment with cuisines from around the world—from elegant platters to aromatic fish soups, every dish caters to diverse tastes.

Refine recipes based on customer feedback, upgrade facilities, hire charismatic staff, and transform your diner into the world’s most beloved culinary hotspot.

​Branching Storylines​

Beyond gameplay, the game weaves a thrilling narrative. During your adventures, meet characters with unique personalities, forge meaningful bonds, and unravel the secrets of this world. Every choice impacts the story, unlocking side quests and leading to unexpected endings.

Join us in Fishing Girl's Fantasy and set sail on an adventure brimming with wonder, heartwarming moments, and endless surprises!
